text:
maria: FYI started the v2 rollout 22:00 UTC, deploybot shifted 10% to v2. Seeing a small spike in mobile streaming failures (422) for long sessions. tagging ops.

deploy-bot: deploybot: shift v2 -> 10% (operator: maria). Canary window open.

jamal: @maria can you paste an example error and affected endpoints? mobile SDK or gateway?

maria: Endpoint: POST /v2/chat/stream, errors come from gateway returning 422 when clients keep an idle stream > 60s. Mobile only (iOS + Android), web looks fine. Sample log:
```
2026-03-15T22:05:12Z gateway ERROR request_id=abc123 status=422 client=mobile-sdk session_len=75s
body: "invalid sequence for streaming session"
```

carla: This smells like header negotiation/case sensitivity on the streaming upgrade handshake. Any recent proxy change in the edge? ops_lead?

ops_lead: No config flips in edge yesterday. However we rolled a small TLS proxy tweak in the mobile route at 21:50. Reverting risk? low but could impact active long-polling semantics.

jamal: Suggest we pause the v2 shift and pin mobile clients to v1 while we triage. Deploybot: can you pause and pin mobile UA header? 

deploy-bot: command queued: pause shift for v2. Current shift: 10% -> paused. Note: operator confirmation required to pin client signals.

maria: Confirm pause. We should issue a client-side pin: add rule to routing: if user-agent =~ /RedwoodMobile/ then route->v1. Ops, can you hotpatch routing rule? Example rule:
```
if headers['user-agent'].match(/RedwoodMobile/) {
  route.version = "v1"
}
```

ops_lead: Will patch. ETA 8m. Also opening a rollback play if revert of TLS tweak is faster.

carla: I'll update the release notes & notify SDK owners. Note to release-notes: "v2 streaming handshake: temporary hold for mobile clients; investigating 422s on long sessions." Keep it short.

jamal: After pin applied, can we resume v2 to 5% for extra telemetry? Prefer slow canary vs full resume.

maria: Yes resume to 5% once pin in place. Deploybot: resume 5% when rule applied.

deploy-bot: ack. Waiting on operator confirmation after rule application.

ops_lead: routing rule pushed and live. Verifying metrics.

maria: Verified - mobile 422 rate back to baseline on pinned sessions. Resume to 5% now please.

deploy-bot: shift v2 -> 5% (operator: maria). Canary resumed.

carla: SDK owners pinged in #eng-devex to triage handshake and produce a mitigation patch for next SDK release.

jamal: Tracking ticket created: #INFR-2314 "v2 streaming: mobile handshake 422 for long sessions". Assigning to jamal+carla.

maria: Thanks. Action items: 1) keep v2 at 5% till next patch, 2) rollback TLS proxy if telemetry points there, 3) update release notes with a note about mobile pin. I'll close this thread after 48h of stable metrics. :thumbsup:
